_: Parc de Wolvendael: what stands on its boundary, from the OSM park polygon (way 14384466), the OSM gate nodes and a look-only Street View check (Google, Apr 2024 car imagery + a Jan 2017 user sphere; nothing stored, traced or shipped). Our own words and city coordinates (x, z m). tools/parkfence/build.mjs reads it.

fenceTypes.mesh: dark green welded-mesh panels, ~1.8 m, on round green posts every ~2.5 m (the Dieweg forecourt and lawn sides); at the west corner the same line is green chain-link on posts with braces. Read as one type: a green mesh panel.
fenceTypes.grand: the Avenue Wolvendael frontage at the main gate: a dressed pale stone plinth ~0.8 m with a black wrought-iron railing on it, square bars ~12 cm apart, spear tops, two flat rails; ~1.8 m of iron over the plinth; rusticated pale stone piers (~0.7 m square, ~3.2 m) at the gate and every few bays

hedges: the playground entrance on Avenue Paul Stroobant: a clipped hedge ~1.5 m on the street side with the green mesh at the gate (we draw the mesh; the hedge is not part of this kit)

sections.note: Avenue Wolvendael either side of the main gate (Street View 2024: plinth + spear railing + stone piers, then green mesh further on)

entrances.note: the big gate at the end of the Dieweg tram loop: a cobbled forecourt leads to two tall pale stone piers and a black iron double gate swung open into the park; green mesh either side
